subject: Request: temporary model-binding & region-only traffic carve-out for Athena pilot
messages:
From: Alice Moreno <alice@athena.ai>
To: kimberly_park@redwood.com
Cc: procurement@athena.ai
Date: Tue, 01 May 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Athena pilot: requirement for region-only traffic & pinned model for POC

Hi Kim,

Thanks again for the demo last week — our engineers were impressed with throughput. We want to run a four-week POC in APAC (Singapore) with a subset of live production traffic. Two constraints from our side:

- Data residency & policy: all inference must stay in APAC and not fall back to other regions.
- Determinism: we need the POC to use the same verified variant (we'll call it "athena-v1-safe") for all calls — no on-the-fly fallback to newer variants or larger models.

Can Redwood provide a temporary carve-out that pins traffic to APAC and disables cross-region fallback for the POC window? We'll sign an SOW (attached) and are happy to accept any performance SLAs that come with the exception.

Practical ask: start date May 15, duration 4 weeks, up to 250 requests/sec during peak. We also need an ops contact for quick incident response during the window.

Thanks — Alice
Alice Moreno
Product Manager, Athena AI
---
Attached: Athena_SOW_v2.pdf
From: kimberly_park@redwood.com
To: alice@athena.ai, procurement@athena.ai
Cc: marcus_lin@redwood.com, lauren_bishop@redwood.com, dev_patel@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 01 May 2028 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Athena pilot: requirement for region-only traffic & pinned model for POC

Alice — thanks for the note and the SOW. Looping in Marcus (ops), Dev (runtime) and Lauren (legal/compliance) to evaluate the ask. A quick summary of next steps on our side:

- Marcus/ops: assess capacity and blackout windows for APAC-only routing; confirm whether we can enforce a region-only policy for a short-term pilot.
- Dev/runtime: confirm model pinning support and what compatibility guarantees we can provide for the "athena-v1-safe" variant (quantization/latency tradeoffs).
- Legal/Compliance: check whether special carve-outs need an exec signoff or modification to our standard SLA/term language.

We should be able to give you a firm yes/no and any constraints by end of week (May 4).

Kim
Kimberly Park
Director, Partnerships (Redwood Inference)
From: marcus_lin@redwood.com
To: kimberly_park@redwood.com, dev_patel@redwood.com
Cc: lauren_bishop@redwood.com, hannah_schmitt@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 04 May 2028 15:27:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Athena pilot: requirement for region-only traffic & pinned model for POC

Folks — quick operational readout after sprinting with runtime:

- Region-only routing: feasible as a temporary policy. We can create a tenant-level routing rule that pins traffic to APAC (sg-1) and refuses cross-region failover. That will bypass automatic fallback; if capacity is exceeded we will return an explicit 503.

- Model pinning: runtime supports variant pinning per-tenant. We can lock the model name/sha for the POC to "athena-v1-safe". Warning: pinned variant will not receive automated perf/quality rollouts; any bug/regression on that variant is the POC owner's risk unless we run a manual rollback.

- Risk/observability: we recommend enabling token-level tracing and an SLO of p95 latency mapped in the Console. We'll add a temporary alerting channel to Athena's ops alias.

Blocks/asks from ops:
- We need signed exception authorizing no-fallback behavior (engineering can't override tenant rule without exec approval).
- Confirm expected RPS profile (attached pilot-traffic-matrix.csv looks OK but please confirm peak concurrency and burst tolerance).

I'll standby for legal confirmation and an exec signoff note.

Marcus Lin
Principal Ops Engineer, Redwood Inference
---
Attached: pilot-traffic-matrix.csv
From: lauren_bishop@redwood.com
To: kimberly_park@redwood.com, marcus_lin@redwood.com, dev_patel@redwood.com
Cc: hannah_schmitt@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 10 May 2028 16:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Athena pilot: requirement for region-only traffic & pinned model for POC

Thanks everyone for the assessments. Legal has reviewed; decision and approval below.

Decision (conditional approval):
- We can approve a temporary carve-out that enforces APAC-only routing and model pinning for the POC window (May 15 — June 12).
- Conditions: Athena must sign the attached limited exception addendum and accept the following clauses:
  1) No-fallback service behavior: Redwood will not route traffic outside APAC for the tenant for the exception window; in return Athena accepts explicit 503s when capacity is reached.
  2) Variant liability: Athena owns model-quality issues for the pinned variant during the pilot; Redwood will not auto-promote fixes to pinned variants.
  3) Security & audits: Athena must complete the APAC data residency questionnaire and provide network allowlists for the ops alert channel.

Operational next steps: Marcus and Dev — please build the tenant rule and the alerting channel. Kim — please get final signatures on the addendum and share procurement contact timeline. Hannah — we'll need a short roll-forward runbook in case we need to terminate the carve-out early.

I'll prepare the addendum template and loop in Finance for any billing implications.

Lauren Bishop
Head of Legal & Compliance (Redwood Inference)
